entries.title: Exodus 22:1
segments: ¶If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep. {or a sheep: or, or a goat}

words.text: . {or a sheep: or, or a goat}

entries.title: Exodus 22:2
segments: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, [there shall] no blood [be shed] for him.

entries.title: Exodus 22:3
segments: If the sun be risen upon him, [there shall be] blood [shed] for him; [for] he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

words.text: [shed] for him; [for] he should make full
; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold

entries.title: Exodus 22:4
segments: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

entries.title: Exodus 22:5
segments: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

entries.title: Exodus 22:6
segments: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed [therewith]; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

words.text: , so that the stacks of corn

entries.title: Exodus 22:7
segments: ¶If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

entries.title: Exodus 22:8
segments: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, [to see] whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.

entries.title: Exodus 22:9
segments: For all manner of trespass, [whether it be] for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, [or] for any manner of lost thing, which [another] challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; [and] whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

words.text: , [or] for any manner of lost thing

entries.title: Exodus 22:10
segments: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing [it]:

entries.title: Exodus 22:11
segments: [Then] shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept [thereof], and he shall not make [it] good.

words.text: [thereof], and he shall not make [it] good

entries.title: Exodus 22:12
segments: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

words.text: from him, he shall make restitution

entries.title: Exodus 22:13
segments: If it be torn in pieces, [then] let him bring it [for] witness, [and] he shall not make good that which was torn.

words.text: If it be torn in pieces

entries.title: Exodus 22:14
segments: And if a man borrow [ought] of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof [being] not with it, he shall surely make [it] good.

entries.title: Exodus 22:15
segments: [But] if the owner thereof [be] with it, he shall not make [it] good: if it [be] an hired [thing], it came for his hire.

words.text: thereof [be] with it, he shall not make [it] good

entries.title: Exodus 22:16
segments: ¶And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

entries.title: Exodus 22:17
segments: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins. {pay: Heb. weigh}

words.text: her unto him, he shall pay

entries.title: Exodus 22:18
segments: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

words.text: Thou shalt not suffer a witch

entries.title: Exodus 22:19
segments: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 22:20
segments: He that sacrificeth unto [any] god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

words.text: only, he shall be utterly destroyed

entries.title: Exodus 22:21
segments: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 22:22
segments: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

entries.title: Exodus 22:23
segments: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

entries.title: Exodus 22:24
segments: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

entries.title: Exodus 22:25
segments: ¶If thou lend money to [any of] my people [that is] poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

words.text: by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer

entries.title: Exodus 22:26
segments: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

entries.title: Exodus 22:27
segments: For that [is] his covering only, it [is] his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I [am] gracious.

words.text: ? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth
unto me, that I will hear

entries.title: Exodus 22:28
segments: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people. {gods: or, judges}

entries.title: Exodus 22:29
segments: Thou shalt not delay [to offer] the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me. {the first...: Heb. thy fulness} {liquors: Heb. tear}

words.text: [to offer] the first of thy ripe fruits
unto me. {the first...: Heb. thy fulness} {liquors: Heb. tear}

entries.title: Exodus 22:30
segments: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, [and] with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

words.text: it shall be with his dam

entries.title: Exodus 22:31
segments: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat [any] flesh [that is] torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

words.text: unto me: neither shall ye eat
